# Naqsh-e-Noor

> Luxury handcrafted embroidery atelier, bridal design house, and artisanal decorative hoop studio.

## Overview
Naqsh-e-Noor is an authentic Indian Slow Craft and handcrafted embroidery atelier. We combine heritage zardozi, fine silk threads, delicate botanical needlework, and custom bridal trousseau embroidery for collectors, brides, and luxury interiors.

## Collections
- **Bridal Collection**: Bespoke bridal embroidery, ornate metallic thread motifs, personalized wedding date keepsakes, and traditional zardozi heirlooms.
- **Floral Collection**: Botanical needlework capturing intricate seasonal blossoms, garden palettes, and delicate pastel petals.
- **Hoop Collection**: Framed artisan wall hoops on natural premium linen and solid wooden frames for wall décor and interior spaces.
- **Embroidery Collection**: Celebrations of slow craft, featuring intricate thread density, geometric borders, and traditional motifs.
- **Hues Collection**: Expressive color gradients, layered pigment work, and tonal harmony.

## Craftsmanship & Materials
- 100% slow needlework crafted by skilled artisans.
- Premium materials: raw silk, metallic zari, organic linen, and durable wooden hoops.
- Every piece is custom-tailored or produced in limited bespoke editions.

## Inquiries & Custom Commissions
- **Official Website**: https://naqsh-e-noor.in/
- **Orders & Direct Inquiries**: Customers can place orders, request customizations, and connect via direct WhatsApp message from the storefront.
- **Shipping**: Worldwide and pan-India shipping available.
